title: Religion
tagline: Scriptures, theologians, mystics and reformers from Hesiod and the Hebrew Bible to the 20th century
hero_caption: Christ Enthroned, Book of Kells, folio 32v, c. 800 (Trinity College Library, Dublin)
intro: The religious texts, thinkers and movements of the Western tradition: Greco-Roman religion, Judaism and Christianity in its Catholic, Orthodox and Protestant forms, from Hesiod and the Hebrew Bible to the Second Vatican Council. It is written as history of religion, describing what each tradition holds and what modern scholarship says about authorship and dating, without taking sides. Manuscripts, early printed editions, icons and portraits come from Wikimedia Commons.
